m.d: A type is one thing or a group of things that are all members of a larger group because of some similarity.
m.e: I use the same type of camera at work.

m.d: A type is a person who is like people from a particular group who are all similar in some way.
m.e: He's not the usually football type.

m.d: Type is letters that have been printed by a machine.
